description.narrative:
Support of capacity building and policy development for advocacy and partnerships through regional development networks.

Strengthening of advocacy at international level, especially towards the UN system, to secure sustainable and inclusive development in Agenda 2030 and beyond.

Increase the influence of trade unions on development policies at national, regional and global levels.

Improvement of trade union partnerships based on the trade union principles on development effectiveness, shared approaches and common objectives.

Strengthen the capacity of national organisations who are members of ITUC

comment.narrative: This indicator will count the number of key stakeholders for the project as in persons among the total of persons to whom information on local and regional recruitment and radicalisation as in the results of the conducted research studies has been shared via an event or a document. The total number of participants of the event will also be assessed.The four studies arepracticionerfriendly literature reviewrole of social media for youth radicalizationrole of womeninterlinkages of radicalisation dynamics at regional and local level

Value reported corresponds to the Direction Gnrale de la Sret Nationale of Morocco and the Maritime National Guard of Tunisia. These institutions were supported through equipment delivery and training.
